715140101.text: Hey! Happy Lantern Rite, esteemed ones!

715140102.text: You guys have been having fun? How about going on a special adventure with me?

715140103.text: Wow, you called us "esteemed ones"! Such a great attitude!

715140104.text: Recently, we've been having a lot of fun! But... why is Paimon getting a strange feeling that we've met before?

715140105.text: You guys are extremely diligent adventurers, so I'm sure we've bumped into each other at some point!

715140106.text: I'm Tiantian. I usually hang out around the Feiyun Slope, looking to recruit new people into the Adventurers' Guild.

715140107.text: Everyone and their cats and dogs passing by have probably heard my voice!

715140109.text: Yes! It means my efforts were noticed by you guys! All the more reason for you to experience my masterpiece!

715140112.text: At this point, of course we'll lend you a hand!

715140113.text: Can you tell us a little bit about your particular adventure?

715140114.text: Sure, then I'll cut to the chase!

715140115.text: Recently I came across a new novel at the Wanwen Bookhouse... no, that's not it. Rather, I gathered some new information!

715140116.text: I've noticed that people's expectations for adventure are rising and activities such as climbing and wind gliding are not as exciting as they used to be.

715140117.text: In order to get more people to join the Adventurers' Guild, we need to come up with more novel and exciting approaches.

715140118.text: So, I teamed up with a couple of other recruiters, pooled together our resources, consulted a few expert mountain climbers and fireworks craftsmen, and designed a new racing challenge!

715140119.text: There are many mechanisms laid out in the challenge. Just step on them and use the momentum from the fireworks and gunpowder blasts to accelerate into the sky!

715140120.text: Fireworks? Gunpowder!? So for the challenge, you want to... blast people into the sky!?!?

715140111.text: Doesn't ring a bell? Then I shall make a bigger impression with this masterpiece... No, I shall do it to recruit more people into the Adventurers' Guild.
